purpose: Bind the bounded production release authority repair to current documentation without claiming provider secret values, deployment success, runtime identity, merge authority, database mutation, publication, billing, or destructive-action authority.

claims: .github/workflows/deploy.yml must keep GitHub production deployment-plane credentials limited to SUPABASE_DB_URL, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID while preserving provider-held Worker runtime secret values; canonical Deploy must only actively write the fail-closed FOUNDER_SIGNAL_AUTOMATION_GRANT_JSON runtime secret and cannot treat public DEPLOY_URL configuration as secret authority.

.github/workflows/playwright.yml must run the Production Playwright Exact-SHA Witness only after a successful canonical Deploy, bind EXPECTED_RELEASE_SHA to that Deploy run head, use the canonical public API and Pages origins, and require direct Worker plus public release identity to remain equal to the same exact SHA across the browser journey.

wrangler.worker.toml must declare the canonical Worker runtime secret names as provider-held required bindings, including FOUNDER_SESSION_ENCRYPTION_KEY, so missing required runtime bindings fail closed at the Cloudflare deployment membrane without requiring canonical Deploy to copy secret values through GitHub Actions.
